### Experimental cultures (`culture_info`)

This dataset contains information about the 192 cultures of the experiment.

```{r experimental-cultures}
culture_info = read.csv(here("data", "RelativeSize_culture_info.csv"), header = TRUE)
```

```{r, eval = displays_datasets}
datatable(culture_info[,1:10],
          rownames = FALSE,
          options = list(scrollX = TRUE),
          filter = list(position = 'top', 
                        clear = FALSE))
```
